environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer with no origin access restrictions. The ALB forwards all traffic directly to the NestJS application on port 3000. The service runs as root in a Docker container with the host filesystem mounted at /var/app. No request signing or authentication middleware is configured at the infrastructure level. Security groups allow inbound 443/80 from 0.0.0.0/0 to the ALB, and the ALB target group health checks pass on /health.

config.filesystem: host volume mount at /var/app with rw permissions
config.network: ALB public-facing, no WAF, no origin restrictions
config.iam_role: ec2-document-service-role with S3 and SSM access
